title: One plain close
summary: The page's one close, plain: “Quoting us with credit is always fine.”, the quiet door to /contact and the Privacy policy as the onward destination.

reference.kelwin: The line comes from this document (privacy clause 06 / terms clause 04), not from the homepage.

story: Ends the document with the one thing a reader might do next, and the other document.

[K] 'Talk to the team' → /contact (asking to republish is general correspondence)

notes: Follows the paper document, so its top is a hard surface cut (no rule). Coherence pass 3: door line recast from “…; ask before you republish.” (a “before you” shape the Deliverability note's door also used); on tablets it steps to 40px, under the h1.
